ctx.x: I didn't want any parts because I told, I knew Zutt and I would not stay together. Because I couldn't play with him in the 50 big band. And I knew if I was playing all over jobs we would have separated. That's all. I wanted to be just a housewife. And at that time, I mean, then we sent for his mother. You know, his mother was living with us too. And she wasn't well. But I did not want I didn't want to play piano. And I was so glad to get out of it.

Because as I said to Zutt, Zutt was a jealous man and I knew we just couldn't go through that fighting about, I know he'd say I was going with one of the musicians. Oh what a man, he was so, you never saw anybody as jealous as he was.
